title: Let fresh progress override stale activity
summary: Prevent active scans from being labeled stale when ActiveJobs confirms the pipeline process is still running.
reason: The previous stale-progress guard decorated activity as stale based only on pipeline_progress.json freshness. During a long source scan, pipeline_progress.json can pause at CurrentStage=scanning while ActiveJobs and pipeline_events continue updating.
behavior_before: A live scan with a running pipeline PID could still show pipeline_state=stale and stale topbar labels if progress LastUpdate was older than the stale threshold.
behavior_after: When progress looks stale but ActiveJobs reports a live pipeline job, snapshot activity is built from current progress instead of being decorated as stale. Orphaned progress with no live job remains stale.

rollback_plan: Revert the ActiveJobs freshness override in snapshot_runner.py and remove the corresponding snapshot-runner regression test.
